content.content: 1. Necessity: the dependent needs the undo promise for restoring an operation boundary — without it, restoring is motiveless. Fail if the edge can be dropped without loss. 2. License: no element of the elaboration contradicts the parent. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: Selection is where the undo leg meets the restoration; the gate keeps the use sound without testing undo itself.
